profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Lithic
profile.summary: I ship systems where correctness and real-time guarantees matter. At Lithic, I lead initiatives across payment decisioning, risk, and fraud controls. Previously, I built identity infrastructure at SentiLink, advertising systems at Amazon, trading systems at Poloniex, and data pipelines at InfoTrust.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Drove cross-team efforts to redesign tokenization decisioning and launch configurable rules across tokenization, wires, and ACH, centralizing controls for 27M+ cards.
• Owned cross-org migration of decisioning for merchant-locked cards to a rules engine. Scaled from 40K to 6.5M+ active rules, cutting downstream transaction-processing load by 75%.
• Architected a real-time behavioral fraud signal framework across card and ACH transactions, later reducing infrastructure costs by 97% to enable rollout across all customers.
• Led support for partial and padded authorization approvals with a partner team and corrected network response codes, avoiding $1MM+ per year in overages and network penalties.
positions.insights: Skills: PostgreSQL · Web Applications · Python (Programming Language) · C++ · Vue.js · Docker · Linux · Distributed Systems · Claude Code · Rust (Programming Language) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Kafka · Software Development · Redis · JavaScript · HTML · Snowflake · Terraform · TypeScript

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: • Partnered with a high-volume customer onboarding 10K+ users per month to build shared PII detection across users and tenants, surface fraud checks on versioned data, reduce KYC/KYB false positives by 60%, and become their source of truth for PII.
positions.insights: Skills: PostgreSQL · Web Applications · Python (Programming Language) · Docker · Linux · Distributed Systems · React.js · Rust (Programming Language) · ChatGPT · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Software Development · JavaScript · TypeScript

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Architected a PII encryption/search platform spanning all products, aligned security and infrastructure, driving adoption by three major U.S. banks and $2MM+ ARR.
• Led an MVP to assess small business risk for a major bank, coordinating across product, infrastructure, and security to generate real-time risk signals and cluster credit applications.
• Redesigned core scoring API to support multiple models and 200K+ daily credit applications at launch, enabling 50+ banks and fintechs to adopt new products instantly.
